name: grc-wildfire-emsr918
notes:
This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR918. On 13 August 2026 at 12:00 CET, a wildfire started in the Chalkidiki Regional Unit of the Central Macedonia Region, Greece, near the village of Siviri. The residents of Siviri and Fourka were evacuated, while more than 170 firefighters and 15 aerial assets were involved in suppression operations, supported by municipal machinery and volunteer organisations. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide initial rough estimation, fire extent and damage assessment emergency mapping.

**Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR918

**Product types present in this dataset's resources:**  
**DEL (Delineation)**: maps the extent of the event itself (eg. flood, fire, landslide boundary).

Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.

organization.description:
Copernicus is the Earth observation component of the European Union’s Space programme. It offers information services that draw from satellite Earth Observation and in-situ (non-space) data.
It sets out to fulfil the growing need amongst European policy- makers, businesses, scientists and individuals to access timely accurate information services. By delivering vast amounts of Earth observation data through a unified system, this innovative programme starts a new chapter in the way we manage the environment, understand and mitigate the effects of climate change and ensure civil security for a safer and more sustainable future.
